faq1Q: Is SakhiBiz completely free to use?
faq1A: Yes, SakhiBiz is 100% free for all women entrepreneurs. All lessons, business tools, and AI mentorship are accessible at zero cost.
faq2Q: Can I use this on a simple mobile phone?
faq2A: Absolutely! SakhiBiz is optimized for low-bandwidth mobile devices with responsive layouts and lightweight pages.
faq3Q: Is my expense and profit calculation data secure?
faq3A: Yes, your calculation data is securely stored on your local device. We never sell or share your micro-business figures.
faq4Q: Does SakhiBiz directly issue government loans or certificates?
faq4A: SakhiBiz is an educational platform. We provide factual guides on how to access Mudra loans and Udyam MSME registration directly via official portals.

aboutHeroIntro: SakhiBiz is a regional e-learning and grassroots business enablement platform dedicated to rural and semi-urban Indian women entrepreneurs. Our mission is to make practical financial literacy, secure digital payments, WhatsApp commerce, and micro-business management accessible to every aspiring entrepreneur in her preferred language.
aboutCompanyText: Developed as part of the Erazone initiative, SakhiBiz brings its existing digital learning and business-support experience together in one platform.
